$comment: Single source of truth for projects and IEEE Climate Chain tracks. Read by the gateway (/api/v1/projects, /apps/<id>/) and frontend. Each project declares every fitting track. Folder paths are relative to climate-chain/projects/. Stage ids: sense, verify, act, finance, prove.

tracks.label: Carbon Markets & Emissions Transparency
tracks.detail: Measure, verify, issue and trace climate claims across carbon projects, emissions and credit markets.

tracks.label: Renewable Energy & Energy Trading
tracks.detail: Match clean generation and demand, validate certificates, and support reliable energy decisions.

tracks.label: Sustainable Supply Chains
tracks.detail: Trace waste, agricultural residue and buyer or municipal handoffs toward lower-impact operations.

tracks.label: Climate Data & Environmental Monitoring
tracks.detail: Collect, validate and interpret environmental observations with source, location, timing and integrity evidence.

projects.name: Climate Chain
features: One guided mission path
Unified gateway for four live APIs
Registry-driven launchpad for every merged project
projects.evidence: 4 live API sources with clearly labeled offline fallbacks

projects.name: JunkSnap
features: Privacy blur and stacked photo checks
10-person site verification
Ward and elected-seat mapping with cited letters
projects.evidence: Project-reported field run: 121 reports across 44 sites

projects.name: clearsky
features: Hindi and Punjabi WhatsApp field intake
Burn Risk Radar and village alerts
Baler and buyer routing for straw
Estimated farmer payouts from demo buyer prices
projects.evidence: Live pilot dashboard and AWS API; payout figures are estimates from demo prices

projects.name: Teesri Shikayat
features: Hindi Telegram and voice-note intake
3 homes within 250 m in 72 hours
Resident-controlled case closure
projects.evidence: Project README reports 66 tests and measured incident cost

projects.name: The Vayu Project
projects.descriptor: One place, one provenance-backed air answer
features: Monitor name, distance and reading age
24-hour exposure dial and language assistant
ESP32-S3 room sensor and DIY air cleaner
projects.evidence: Live OpenAQ, Open-Meteo and FIRMS data; measured hours are labeled

projects.name: AquaQuest
features: Guided water observations and photo reports
Offline-installable PWA
Challenges, learning library and community feed
projects.evidence: Frontend prototype; local and mock data

projects.name: PLUME
projects.descriptor: Methane detection to verified repair funding
features: DBSCAN grouping and explainable repair ranking
Verifier-signed EIP-712 escrow
Public receipt for every workflow step
projects.evidence: 10,098 historical Carbon Mapper detections; repair activity and funds are simulated

projects.name: CarbonLens
projects.descriptor: Satellite checks for forest credit claims
features: Random-forest land classification and bias correction
Change detection for reversals
Unique serials and report hashes on-chain

projects.name: CarbonShield
features: Stress tests for baselines and leakage
Measurement and carbon-stock challenges
Phase 3 artifact audit API and React auditor UI
projects.evidence: Research-stage sensitivity analysis over project artifacts; no central adapter
projects.readiness: Local research UI and read-only API

projects.name: CarbonTwin
features: TF-IDF candidate matching and local LLM review
Smart-contract issuance guard
Merkle-anchored findings
projects.evidence: Demo scan: 18 shared-vintage pairs, about 2.49M tCO₂e

projects.name: EcoGraph
features: FalkorDB checks for double retirement and trading loops
11 MCP tools with human-reviewed freezes
Flutter app and web map
projects.evidence: Synthetic evaluation: 7/7 planted cases found; 0 false alarms

projects.name: grounded
features: 72-hour solar, battery and grid dispatch
245-policy search with holdout validation
Physical investment search for critical loads

projects.name: rantai-3c
features: Cloud upload and carbon analysis
Sepolia contracts, NFT certificates and DAO governance
Offset marketplace with ETH and PayPal flows
projects.evidence: Some flows are simulated; public project URL currently mismatches this app

projects.name: CarbonTrace
projects.descriptor: Carbon credits checked against satellite evidence before they exist
features: AI verifier scores monthly NDVI and signs an EIP-712 attestation
Registry contract claims every land cell per year; a second claim reverts
Content-addressed evidence bundles re-hashed in the browser
projects.evidence: Project README reports 27 contract tests, 50 backend tests and 8 frontend tests
projects.readiness: Local demo (make run) and Docker Compose

projects.name: ClimateProof AI
projects.descriptor: Environmental dataset integrity checks before anyone trusts them
features: CSV schema validation, missing-value and duplicate detection
Invalid timestamp and humidity/PM2.5 range checks with IQR outlier signals
File-integrity verification and downloadable integrity report
projects.evidence: Synthetic sample dataset; outliers are exploratory signals, not proof of manipulation

projects.name: Flarewatch
projects.descriptor: Niger Delta gas flares, seen from space, recorded where nobody can edit them
features: Nightly NASA FIRMS VIIRS detections from three satellites
Write-once SHA-256 of each night anchored on a Solana program
Persistent-flare rule (3+ nights in 7 days) with a method hash fixed on-chain
projects.evidence: First week (15–20 Oct 2026): 48 persistent flares across 91 hotspot sites and 675 detections
projects.readiness: Live web app and Solana devnet program

projects.name: GridProof
projects.descriptor: Hour-by-hour clean energy certificates, checked and recorded on-chain
features: Signed hourly meter readings per solar or wind device
AI integrity check against Open-Meteo weather before minting
One certificate per device-hour on-chain, retired by the hour

projects.name: HourMatch
projects.descriptor: Renewable certificates per plant per hour, and a checker for green-power claims
features: Hourly certificates from several issuers, one shared retirement state
Transfer-once rule and wallet-bound company retirement
Claim checker and hour-by-hour evaluation against Taipower open data
projects.evidence: Eval results and holdout runs in eval/; all companies and plants are fictional demo data

projects.name: PlotLock
projects.descriptor: One on-chain attestation per plot per season, bound to satellite evidence
features: H3 cell land registry that reverts on any overlapping plot
One claim per plot and season
Oracle-signed NoBurn / Burned / Uncertain verdicts from FIRMS and Sentinel-2
projects.evidence: Four demo plots with fixture evidence; Sentinel-2 items are real Planetary Computer measurements
projects.readiness: Demo map and Polygon Amoy testnet contract

focuses.label: Methane and flaring

focuses.label: Clean power, hour by hour
focuses.detail: Certificates and dispatch that match real generation

focuses.label: Resilient power

focuses.label: Community stewardship
focuses.detail: Observe, learn and coordinate local action
